beats_top.why: The #1 result is Cornell's own fitness centers page, which covers students and employees and never says whether alumni can join. Our first paragraph answers 'probably not' with the rule quoted and links, then gives the day-pass route, the NYC club option, and priced Ithaca alternatives.
